propositions: Implement lizard-based complexity analyzer that computes true cyclomatic complexity (CCN) per function across ~25 languages via the metrics extra.
When metrics extra is not installed, guard_import raises OptionalDependencyError which must be caught and converted to Unavailable with reason and accruing_since.
Analyzer must populate AnalyzerResult.complexity with per-file and aggregate CCN values by scanning the repository root.
Unit tests must exercise the analyzer on Python and at least one non-Python language (e.g., JavaScript) to validate polyglot parsing.
Missing optional dependency path must be tested to verify Unavailable is returned with correct reason and timestamp fields.
